name: Vilobí del Penedès (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the white dog of the arms carrying a piece of yellow bread in its mouth.
history: The flag was approved in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya of 15 May 1992; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with the white dog of the arms carrying a piece of yellow bread in its mouth at the centre, the dog half the height of the cloth.
